title: No Atomic Migration Mechanism Between Strategies
rootCause: Migration from AutoPoolYieldStrategy to ERC4626YieldStrategy requires per-client totalWithdrawal (24h timelock each) followed by depositAsOwner on the new strategy. Not atomic, not batched.
impact: For N clients, migration takes N * 24h minimum. Funds idle during migration lose yield. No mechanism to transfer accounting state between strategies.
recommendation: Consider implementing a batch migration function or strategy-to-strategy transfer that preserves client accounting.
